file_insights.purpose: API endpoint views for purchase request and order management
key_components: api_approved_requests - endpoint listing approved purchase requests
api_order_items - endpoint listing items in a purchase order

patterns_discovered.description: Both endpoints use @login_required decorator for access control
patterns_discovered.implication: Consistent security pattern applied to API endpoints

patterns_discovered.description: Uses select_related() to eagerly load related objects (requester, warehouse, material)
patterns_discovered.implication: Performance optimization to reduce N+1 queries

patterns_discovered.description: Data transformation from model instances to dictionaries using list comprehensions
patterns_discovered.implication: Clean, readable approach to API response formatting

patterns_discovered.description: Uses float(), str() conversions for JSON compatibility
patterns_discovered.implication: Ensures numeric and ID fields are properly serialized

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: api_order_items response structure differs from api_approved_requests
gotchas_discovered.description: api_approved_requests returns array directly, api_order_items wraps in object with success flag
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Standardize response structure across all API endpoints

gotchas_discovered.description: api_order_items relies on Django's built-in 404 handling, no custom error response
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Consider consistent error response format across endpoints

gotchas_discovered.description: api_approved_requests loads all approved requests without pagination
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Add pagination for endpoints that could return large datasets

approach_outcome.description: Successfully created api.py with two functional API endpoints
key_achievements: Established API endpoint patterns for future expansion

recommendations.suggestion: Standardize API response structure across all endpoints to use consistent wrapper format
Implement pagination for endpoints that retrieve multiple records (api_approved_requests)
Add try-except blocks and custom error responses for better error handling and debugging
Add request validation (e.g., verify order_id is UUID format) before querying database
Add docstring with request/response examples and possible status codes for API documentation
